newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-BRONDBY TOP OF DANISH LEAGUE AT HALFWAY MARK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRONDBY TOP OF DANISH LEAGUE AT HALFWAY MARK.

text.p: Danish soccer's Super League closed for the winter break at the weekend with Brondby clear at the top despite defeat in their last match.

Brondby, who have won the league title six times, finished the first half of Denmark's July-November season with 37 points from 18 matches. They are five points ahead of second-placed Aalborg, with Aarhus third on 30.

Brondby's last two outings ended in disappointing 3-1 home defeats, the first to Germany's Karsruhe in a UEFA Cup third round first leg match and the second to modest Herfoelge which was their fourth defeat of the domestic league season.
Miklos Molnar of Lyngby is the league's top scorer so far with 18 goals, averaging a goal a game.
